systemLearnedRules.rule: For Christmas, New Year, and when requested by the user, render all primary festive headlines, greetings, and poetic blessing lines in majestic English serif typography rather than Hindi Devanagari.

Whenever the user asks for a printed background, or to fill blank/empty spaces creatively, apply an ornate printed texture (winter_stars for holiday/Christmas, printed_damask or royal_jaali for royal festivals, festive_mandala for temple celebrations) with subtle opacity (7%-10%) to make the poster look like luxury printed stationery.

Kandhari Tent & Caterers must always be prominently displayed at 48px in multi-stop royal metallic gold foil gradient with warm amber glow. Address text must be secondary and cleanly kept inside the extended golden pill with Lucknow.
Never allow festival titles to overflow badges or collide with hero motif artwork. Auto-scale fonts and use multi-line script wrapping when necessary.
